name: @continuum/tui
description: Terminal chat client for Continuum — the maximally-different outlier that validates the SDK client seam (StateConnection READ + chat/send SEND) against Node/ANSI, proving the same seam apps/web's Lit widget uses fits a non-DOM renderer without forcing. UI-only: no substrate logic; the who/what/where projection is @continuum/chat-view, shared with the web widget. Zero RUNTIME deps — the transport is Node ≥22's global WebSocket (no `ws` package); tsx is the dev-time TS loader (Node's --experimental-strip-types only resolves explicit .ts extensions, not the SDK's normal imports). `npm start` runs the interactive client; `npm run frame` draws one live snapshot and exits (headless read-path smoke).
